header.running_head: Spying to Discover Faults in Muslims

blocks.text: declares [وَلَا تَجَسَّسُوْا] 'Do not spy'[^1], you have spied. While Allaah says [وَاْتُوا الْبُيُوْتَ مِنْ اَبْوَابِهَا] 'Enter your homes from their (front) doors'[^2], you have scaled the wall to get to me and have done so without permission whereas Allaah states:

blocks.arabic_text: لَا تَدْخُلُوْا بُيُوْتًا غَيْرَ بُيُوْتِكُمْ حَتّٰى تَسْتَاْنِسُوْا وَتُسَلِّمُوْا عَلٰٓى اَهْلِهَا ذٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُوْنَ
blocks.text: Do not enter any home besides your own until you have acquired permission (to enter from those inside) and (until you have) greeted the inhabitants.

Hadhrat Umar (RA) submitted, "Will you employ the good in you if I overlook what you have been doing?" "Certainly," the man replied. Hadhrat Umar (RA) then pardoned the man, leaving the house and the man alone.[^3]
An Incident of Hadhrat Umar (RA) with an Old Man

Hadhrat Suddi reports that Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) was with Hadhrat Umar (RA) when he saw the light of a fire during the dead of night. Following the light, Hadhrat Umar (RA) entered a house lit by a lantern. There they discovered an old man sitting with some drink and a slave girl who was singing for him. The man perceived nothing until Hadhrat Umar (RA) confronted him. Hadhrat Umar (RA) exclaimed, "To this night, I have never seen a sight uglier than this old man waiting for his death (in such sin)!" The old man lifted his gaze and said, "Quite in order, O Ameerul Mu'mineen! But what you have done is even uglier. You have been spying when Allaah has forbidden it and you have entered without permission."
"You are right," Hadhrat Umar (RA) admitted. As he left biting his garment and weeping, he said, "Umar's mother may well have lost him if his Rabb does not forgive him. This old man thought that he was hiding himself from his family but will now continue sinning saying that Umar has already seen me (what more have I to lose)." The old man then stayed away from Hadhrat Umar (RA)'s gatherings for a while.
Hadhrat Umar (RA) was one day sitting in a gathering when the old man came discreetly and sat amongst the people at the back. Seeing him arrive, Hadhrat Umar (RA) sent someone to summon him. When the person told the old man that Hadhrat Umar (RA) was calling for him, the old man expected that Hadhrat Umar (RA) would now punish him for what he had seen him do. "Come closer to me," Hadhrat Umar (RA) bade the old man. Hadhrat Umar (RA) then kept calling him closer until he seated him right beside him. "Bring your ear closer to me," Hadhrat Umar (RA) told the old man. Hadhrat Umar (RA) then whispered in his ear saying, "Listen! I swear by the Being Who has sent Muhammad ﷺ as a Rasul with the truth that neither I nor Ibn Mas'ood who was with me have informed a soul about what we had seen you doing."
Kharaa'iti, as quoted in Kanzul Ummaal (Vol.2 Pg.167).
